evidence: Cic. Tim. (Univ.) 1: ācer et dīligēns rērum (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: From investīgāre, to track down (see research); with a genitive of the subject. Also an investigator of a crime (conjūrātiōnis, Cic. Sull. 85).
Properly a tracker of game, or one who hunts swarms of bees or springs of water (Columella); a searcher in Plautus and Vitruvius.

phrases.latin: quamquam Varrō noster dīligentissimus investīgātor antīquitātis putat in hōc errātum
phrases.english: although our Varro, a most careful researcher into antiquity, thinks there is a mistake here
